notes: Feeds W8-18t (dialogs::recovery::{layout, list}). Reflection over the internal RecoveryDialog of the PhotoReview (Shell.Win32) assembly; no window is created.

A window-less dialog is RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject(RecoveryDialog) with _avgCharWidth, _lineHeight and an empty _childHosts set by reflection (hwnd 0): ButtonWidth(ids) is then exactly Dx(50).

Output per kind: constants -> ids (28 control ids, snake_case), ss_center, cursor_arrow, cursor_wait; items -> items[] (class, id, text, style, ex_style) in template order; color_ref -> color_ref; sizes -> margin, field_height, button_height, preferred_w, preferred_h, minimum_w, minimum_h.
Texts are the English catalog; style words are the raw uint values.
